## Our History

AG General Construction LLC was founded over 14 years ago by Aaron Garcia, whose passion for home remodeling was shaped by years of hands-on experience working for other reputable contractors in the field. With a deep understanding of the craft and a vision to offer something more personal, Aaron built the company from the ground up—starting with small handyman jobs and home repairs. [...] In the early days, the business operated solely on word of mouth and trusted referrals, serving local families with care, reliability, and skill. What began as a one-man operation has since evolved into a family-owned and fully insured company with a growing team, professional-grade tools, and a proud reputation across the DMV area.

Through the years, we’ve earned the trust of homeowners and industry professionals alike—taking on larger remodeling projects and building strong partnerships with other general contractors. We continue to grow, but one thing remains constant: our commitment to quality craftsmanship, attention to detail, and customized work that reflects each client’s unique vision. # Who we Are

AG General Contractor was founded in the 1980s by Pablo Allamand and Guillermo Gaona with a clear mission—to create meaningful change in both the industry and the communities we serve. From the beginning, our commitment to innovation and client satisfaction set us apart, leading to one of our most notable projects: Santiago Downtown. This ambitious development of seven buildings in the heart of Santiago’s business district became a testament to our expertise and vision.
In the early days, the business operated solely on word of mouth and trusted referrals, serving local families with care, reliability, and skill. What began as a one-man operation has since evolved into a family-owned and fully insured company with a growing team, professional-grade tools, and a proud reputation across the DMV area.

Through the years, we’ve earned the trust of homeowners and industry professionals alike—taking on larger remodeling projects and building strong partnerships with other general contractors. We continue to grow, but one thing remains constant: our commitment to quality craftsmanship, attention to detail, and customized work that reflects each client’s unique vision. “I was selling in Florida, where we lived at the time, and she said, ‘Jess, I got so many compliments from work. “We changed packaging six times inside of one year because the women were like, ‘Can I have this?’ so I did it. ‘Well, we want it to look like this,’ so I did it,” she said. “It felt great; they just wanted it to look different.
